name: CollaborationRequired
summary: The card component of Collaboration Required (DUO_0000020). It reads ProjectMembershipCredential, AffiliationCredential, ScopedAgreementCredential and AgreementCredential, compares them with its policy data, and outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

datasetID.description: DID of the governed dataset. A ScopedAgreementCredential only counts if claims.agreementInfo.scope.dataset equals it.

changes_from_today: Changed from the card's Rego module: the AffiliationCredential is the requester's; the module read the PI's.
